headline: Lightning burst team
title: Lightning Team | Fulmintis Blazen Luminelle | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Here is a Lightning burst team for Aniimo. Fulmintis is the damage dealer. Blazen breaks the enemy so it takes more damage. Luminelle supports the team with buffs. Then the fourth slot is up to you. One guide picks Turbo for extra damage buffs, another picks Besauce for energy regen, and the Turbo version has no healer, so watch long fights. Which fourth Aniimo would you run? Comment below!
description: A Lightning burst team for Aniimo: Fulmintis as DPS, Blazen to Break and Luminelle as support. Guides pick Turbo or Besauce as the fourth member, and the team has no dedicated healer.
